notes:
# Events that ask for your name and email {doc}
Some classes want to know who is joining before they let anyone in.
RecordLah! fills that in from your Attendee details and joins by itself.

# A code sent to your email {envelope}
An event that verifies on every join is answered now: the code is read from
Apple Mail, typed in and submitted, with nobody in the room.

# The meeting that is recording leads the list {film}
It used to sort by when the run started, which put the one thing happening
right now underneath meetings ten days away.

---

Everything else in this release:

- Buttons on an event page are clicked where they actually are, so joining
  no longer takes a few stray clicks to land.
- "Agree and join" is recognised as a way in, whatever its capitals.
- The app no longer offers to record a meeting it is already joining.
- A verification that worked is not thrown away a second later.
- The meeting you are reading stays open while the app saves in the
  background — a transcript or a handout arriving used to send you back to
  the first meeting in the list.
- An unfinished model download that can never be resumed is deleted, and
  the space it was holding comes back.
- A lobby that gives up says what the page was offering, so an event that
  words its button differently can be fixed quickly.
